info.title: Power Platform Admin
info.description: MCP server for cross-environment Power Platform administration through natural language in Copilot Studio. Manages environment settings, capacity allocations, Copilot governance, security recommendations, connectors, apps, agent inventory, and application packages via the Power Platform Admin API.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio integration. Provides cross-environment administration tools for Power Platform.

get.description: List all Power Platform environments with capacity metrics, types, states, and Dataverse URLs.

type.description: Environment type (Production, Sandbox, Developer, Trial, Default)

get.description: Get full details of a specific environment including properties, database settings, capacity, runtime endpoints, and protection status.
Get PPAC management settings for an environment (SAS IP rules, audit logging, etc.).

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of setting names to return. Omit for all settings.

schema.description: Key-value pairs of setting names and their values

post.description: Update one or more PPAC management settings on an environment.

settings.description: Key-value pairs of setting names and their new values

get.description: Check whether an environment draws Copilot Studio message and session capacity (MCSMessages, MCSSessions) from the tenant pool. An environment with no allocation document draws from the pool by default. Uses the documented Allocations By Environment API.

enabled.description: True when the environment draws Copilot Studio capacity from the tenant pool

source.description: Where the state came from: allocationDocument when a document exists, default when none does

MCSMessages.description: Copilot Studio messages capacity draws from the tenant pool

MCSSessions.description: Copilot Studio sessions capacity draws from the tenant pool

post.description: Enable or disable whether an environment draws Copilot Studio message and session capacity (MCSMessages, MCSSessions) from the tenant pool. Reads the current allocation first, changes only the TenantPool enforcement rule, then reads the result back to confirm it. Uses the documented Allocations By Environment API.

enabled.description: True to draw from the tenant pool, false to stop drawing from it

entitlements.description: Entitlements the TenantPool rule was applied to

verified.description: True when the allocation was read back after the write and matched the requested state. False means a concurrent edit may have overwritten it.

get.description: List capacity allocations for every environment in the tenant. Each entry reports the allocated and auto-allocated amount per currency along with its Alert, PayGo, TenantPool, and Deny enforcement rules.

currencyCount.description: Number of currencies allocated to this environment

currencyType.description: Capacity currency, for example MCSMessages or AI

enforcementRules.description: Enforcement rule states keyed by rule type

Alert.description: Notify when the allocation is approached

TenantPool.description: Draw from the shared tenant pool

Deny.description: Stop consumption once the allocation is exhausted

get.description: Get the capacity allocation document for one environment, including every currency and its enforcement rules. Returns hasAllocationDocument false when the environment has never been allocated, which means it inherits tenant defaults rather than that the lookup failed.

hasAllocationDocument.description: False when the environment has no allocation document and inherits tenant defaults

currencyType.description: Capacity currency, for example MCSMessages or AI

enforcementRules.description: Enforcement rule states keyed by rule type

Alert.description: Notify when the allocation is approached

TenantPool.description: Draw from the shared tenant pool

Deny.description: Stop consumption once the allocation is exhausted

allocation.description: The raw allocation document as returned by the service, or null when none exists

post.description: Set the allocated capacity and/or enforcement rules for a single currency on one environment. Reads the current allocation, changes only the named currency, writes the whole document back, then re-reads to verify. Other currencies are preserved. Enabling Deny stops consumption once the allocation is exhausted.

allocated.description: Whole-number quantity to allocate. Omit to leave the current amount unchanged.

enforcementRules.description: Enforcement rules to set. Only the rules listed here change; any others already on the currency are preserved.

ruleType.description: Alert notifies, PayGo bills overage, TenantPool draws from the shared pool, Deny stops consumption at the limit

enabled.description: True to enable the rule, false to disable it

createdCurrencyEntry.description: True when the currency had no prior entry and one was created

hadExistingDocument.description: True when the environment already had an allocation document

from.description: Previous value, or null when newly created

verified.description: True when the allocation was read back after the write and matched the requested state. False means a concurrent edit may have overwritten it.

get.description: Get how much of each entitlement is still available to allocate. Use this before increasing an environment allocation to check the tenant has unallocated capacity left.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional OData filter. The filterable fields are not published, so prefer leaving this blank and narrowing the result yourself.

filter.description: The filter that was applied, or null

availability.description: Availability document as returned by the service

unit.description: Unit of measure: NotSpecified, MB, Count, or Hour

get.description: Get the reserved quantity and unit for each entitlement in the tenant. Reserved capacity is committed to a scope and is not available for new allocations. This does not report enforcement rules.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional OData filter. The filterable fields are not published, so prefer leaving this blank and narrowing the result yourself.

filter.description: The filter that was applied, or null

unit.description: Unit of measure: NotSpecified, MB, Count, or Hour

note.description: Pointer to the allocation operations for enforcement rules

get.description: List every resource threshold configured for a licensing entitlement. A threshold caps how much of an entitlement an environment resource may consume and controls notification and stop behavior. Optionally filter to a single environment.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID to read thresholds for, for example MCSMessages or MCSSessions

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Filter the result to a single environment. Leave blank to return thresholds for every environment.

entitlementId.description: The entitlement the thresholds belong to

environmentId.description: The environment the result was filtered to, or null when unfiltered

createdOn.description: UTC date and time when the threshold was first created

entitlementId.description: Entitlement ID associated with the resource

limit.description: The limit set for resource consumption

notificationThreshold.description: Percentage of the limit at which consumption notifications are sent

notifyIfOverCapacity.description: Whether to notify when consumption reaches the notification threshold

stopIfOverCapacity.description: Whether to stop consuming capacity once the resource exceeds its limit

stopResource.description: Whether the resource has been explicitly stopped. True means the resource is disabled.

post.description: Create or update the resource threshold for an environment resource on a licensing entitlement. Reads the current threshold first and changes only the fields supplied, so unspecified fields keep their existing values.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: The environment ID (GUID) that owns the resource

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID, for example MCSMessages or MCSSessions

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID the threshold applies to

limit.description: The limit set for resource consumption

notificationThreshold.description: Percentage of the limit (0-100) at which consumption notifications are sent

notifyIfOverCapacity.description: True to notify when consumption reaches the notification threshold

stopIfOverCapacity.description: True to stop consuming capacity once the resource exceeds its limit

stopResource.description: True to explicitly stop the resource, putting it in a disabled state

mergedWithExisting.description: True when an existing threshold was found and the supplied fields were merged into it

appliedFields.description: Names of the fields that were set by this call

createdOn.description: UTC date and time when the threshold was first created

entitlementId.description: Entitlement ID associated with the resource

limit.description: The limit set for resource consumption

notificationThreshold.description: Percentage of the limit at which consumption notifications are sent

notifyIfOverCapacity.description: Whether to notify when consumption reaches the notification threshold

stopIfOverCapacity.description: Whether to stop consuming capacity once the resource exceeds its limit

stopResource.description: Whether the resource has been explicitly stopped

get.description: Inventory Copilot Studio and Agent Builder agents, enriched with environment, environment group, sharing, identity, and provenance detail. Each agent carries a computed risk level derived from creation provenance, sharing scope, and environment posture. Leave the environment blank to inventory the whole tenant. Uses the resource query endpoint, which returns undocumented resource properties that may change without notice.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Restrict the inventory to a single environment. Leave blank to inventory every environment in the tenant.

truncated.description: True when the page limit was reached before the tenant was fully enumerated. Narrow the scope with an environment to get a complete result.

environmentId.description: The environment the inventory was scoped to, or null for the whole tenant

schemaName.description: Unique system name used to reference the agent

entraAgentBlueprintId.description: Entra agent identity blueprint the agent identity descends from

entraAppId.description: Entra application ID associated with the agent

environmentType.description: Environment type (Production, Sandbox, Developer, Trial, Default)

environmentIsManaged.description: Whether the environment is a Managed Environment

environmentGroupId.description: Environment group the environment belongs to

createdBy.description: Object ID of the user who created the agent

createdIn.description: Surface the agent was created in (for example, Copilot Studio)

lastPublishedAt.description: When the agent was last published. Blank means never published.

ownerId.description: Object ID of the current owner

authentication.description: Authentication mode configured for the agent

model.description: Primary AI model backing the agent

isManaged.description: Whether the agent is in a managed solution

isCLIAgent.description: Whether the agent was authored through a CLI or code-first path: true, false, or unknown. Unknown means the platform did not report the field and must not be read as false. This is an undocumented property that may change without notice.

sharedWithViewersUserCount.description: Number of users the agent is shared with as viewers

sharedWithViewersGroupCount.description: Number of groups the agent is shared with as viewers

sharedWithViewersEntireTenant.description: Whether the agent is shared with everyone in the tenant

sharedWithEditorsUserCount.description: Number of users the agent is shared with as editors

sharedWithEditorsGroupCount.description: Number of groups the agent is shared with as editors

channels.description: Channels the agent is published to

riskLevel.description: Computed governance risk: None, Low, Medium, or High

riskScore.description: Additive score behind the risk level

riskSignals.description: Named signals that produced the risk score

get.description: Internal operation for dynamic dropdowns. Returns environment IDs and names.
